title: What bitrate does MP3 quality 2 really give?
fullTitle: FFmpeg libmp3lame Quality 2: 32 to 182 kbit/s, Depending on the Signal

scenes.narration: You encode an m p three with dash q colon a two. What bitrate do you get? Quality is not a bitrate. Does one setting always cost the same? We encode five synthetic signals at ten settings, and measure the average two ways.
captions: Five signals, ten settings, two readers.

scenes.narration: Ten seconds of stereo made inside f f m peg: silence, a sine, a chord, a sweep, and white noise. Reader one is f f probe, on packet sizes. Reader two is Node, walking the frame headers itself.
captions: Readers: ffprobe packets, and Node on the frame headers.

scenes.narration: First the control. Dash b colon a one twenty eight k asks for a constant bitrate. All five signals give one hundred and twenty eight kilobits per second, and every frame is a one twenty eight frame. Both readers agree.
captions: Every frame is a 128 kbit/s frame.

scenes.narration: Now one setting, quality two, on the same ten seconds. Silence is thirty two kilobits per second. A sweep is forty three, a sine fifty eight, a chord sixty nine. White noise is one hundred and eighty two: five point seven times more.
captions: Same encoder, same ten seconds, 5.7 times apart.

scenes.narration: Across all ten settings, silence never moves: every frame sits at the thirty two minimum. Noise falls from two hundred and fifty at quality zero to seventy seven at quality nine. A bigger number always costs less, but how much depends on the signal.

Put five seconds of silence before five seconds of noise, at quality two. The file averages one hundred and seven, about the mean of its halves, thirty two point seven and one hundred and eighty two point five. No frame is near it.
captions: 5 s silence + 5 s noise: 107 kbit/s average.

scenes.narration: So quality is a target, not a bitrate. Need a size? Set dash b colon a, and it is exact. Need quality? Encode your own files and read the average with f f probe. Not tested: real music, mono, other builds, players.
captions: Need a size: -b:a. Need quality: measure your files.
Not tested: real music, mono, other builds, players.
